root_provisioning.authority: trusted server configuration plus an allowlisted owner identity
root_provisioning.activation_rule: server verifies the owned directory handle, absence of link or reparse components, exact quota policy, and root identity before activation

compatibility_types.representation: immutable data-only value containing one validated virtual-root identity and normalized relative virtual path
compatibility_types.construction: File(path) parses and validates only the lexical virtual path; it does not open, create, read, write, resolve, or probe a host path

compatibility_types.representation: opaque execution-scoped server handle bound to one authorized File value, opened revision, mode, and cursor

path_contract.normalization: validate already-decoded NFC segments without filesystem normalization
path_contract.case_policy: ordinal case-sensitive identities; creation rejects case-colliding siblings on case-insensitive hosts
forbidden: symlink, junction, mount point, hard-link ambiguity, or reparse point
path_contract.resolution_rule: open from a server-owned virtual-root handle, inspect every existing component without following links, and verify the final handle remains beneath the root

operations.precondition: root READ authorization and exact revision or current head
root LIST authorization and bounded revision-bound cursor
active execution, exact selected caller binding, root authorization, validated File value, exact mode, and exact revision or create revision zero
operations.effect: create one bounded FileHandle in OPEN state with cursor zero; no durable file mutation occurs

operations.precondition: the caller presents the exact active execution, selected caller binding, and OPEN FileHandle token
operations.effect: atomically flush any authorized staged write through the atomic-write contract and transition the handle to CLOSED; otherwise discard the uncommitted stage

operations.precondition: root WRITE authorization, parent revision, and idempotency key
root WRITE authorization, expected file revision or create revision zero, declared encoding, length, digest, and idempotency key
root DELETE authorization, expected node revision, empty-directory proof when applicable, and idempotency key

content_contract.utf8_rule: strict UTF-8 scalar values without byte-order mark; optional newline normalization must be explicitly requested and digest the stored bytes
content_contract.binary_rule: opaque bytes are never decoded, interpreted, imported, rendered as active content, or executed

file_handle.purpose: data-only execution-scoped cursor over one authorized virtual-file revision
file_handle.token: opaque 256-bit server-generated token stored and compared only by SHA-256 digest
file_handle.cursor: nonnegative byte offset bounded by the opened revision or staged content length
file_handle.restart_rule: all OPEN handles become CLOSED and presented pre-restart tokens return STALE_HANDLE; content already atomically committed remains authoritative

file_properties.lexical_rule: basename, dirname, and filename derive only from the already-validated virtual path and never resolve a host path
file_properties.authority_rule: exists, isdir, isfile, canRead, and canWrite derive from one authorized repository snapshot and the exact root ACL revision
file_properties.handle_rule: isOpen is true only for the caller's exact active execution, selected caller binding, token digest, and opened revision

quotas.reservation_rule: reserve the full worst-case byte and node delta inside the write transaction before staging content

atomic_write.metadata_transaction: file revision, root quota counters, content digest, audit record, and outbox event commit with the authoritative replace outcome

recovery.restart_rule: remove uncommitted server-owned temporary files, reconcile committed metadata to exact content digests, and expose no partial write
recovery.quota_rule: recompute and verify quota counters before enabling mutations after inconsistent shutdown
recovery.retry_rule: same idempotency identity and content digest returns the original result

forbidden_capabilities: host absolute path, traversal, link following, device, alternate stream, or path escape
execute, import, evaluate, source, template, macro, shell, process, or dynamic module behavior
URL fetch, DNS, socket, network mount, GCS, mission-network, spacecraft, or legacy-adapter access
unbounded files, directories, paths, listings, or quota consumption
